text:
maya_ae: Kickoff time — Thomas from Gridline is ready to start the 3-week POC. Wanted to align agenda, success criteria, and any security blockers before we send calendar invite. Can we run a 30m sync today?
chris_se: I can do 30m. Agenda draft: 1) stakeholders & access 2) primary use case + sample prompts 3) metrics & evals 4) infra/networking + data handling 5) timeline & deliverables 6) pricing/commit. Sound ok?
thomas_gridline: Works for me. Key goals: reduce average agent handling time by 40% on billing questions, and achieve >=90% answer accuracy on our evaluation set.
maya_ae: Perfect — we'll capture accuracy and latency. Quick question on accuracy: do you have a labeled eval set or do you want us to bootstrap one?
thomas_gridline: We have ~500 labeled examples for billing intents, and can add another 200 if needed.
sam_eng: For latency and throughput sizing — what's expected QPS and typical prompt length?
thomas_gridline: Peak QPS ~2 req/s, avg token length ~120, max 800 tokens for long context.
irene_security: Two quick security checkpoints: 1) is there customer PII in requests? 2) do you require on-prem/private deployment or will hosted with VPC peering suffice?
thomas_gridline: Yes some PII (account numbers). Prefer VPC peering — no on-prem for now.
chris_se: For VPC peering we need network CIDRs and firewall contacts. Also need to confirm KMS integration for keys. Thomas, can you share the security contact and a scanning window?
thomas_gridline: I'll loop in @marie_sec (security) after this thread. CIDR will be 10.40.0.0/16.
maya_ae: Success criteria proposal: 1) Functional: >=90% intent accuracy on billing eval set 2) Latency: p95 inference < 600ms 3) Cost: per-transaction cost <= $0.18 (hosted) 4) Operational: <1% error rate and runbook for fallback. Any objections?\alex_cs: Add adoption metric: internal pilot usage >= 200 queries/day by week 3.
thomas_gridline: Agree on all besides cost — can you confirm pricing assumptions?\maya_ae: Pricing note: the $0.18/tx assumes batching and quantized instance profile. If they prefer reserved capacity we can offer a discounted commit. Chris — can you prepare a quick cost sensitivity table?
chris_se: Will do. Also need to capture prompt templates and eval harness. Thomas — can you share 50 sample prompts and 50 negative examples (expected wrong answers) so we can build automated evals?
thomas_gridline: Yes, attaching a quick sample in email. For the thread: sample prompt ->
```
User: "Why was I billed $123.45 for invoice INV-9876?"
Expected: "It looks like INV-9876 includes prorated charges from subscription change and a one-time setup fee of $10. See billing section."
```
chris_se: Good — we'll create an eval job that computes accuracy and F1 over slots, plus human review for edge cases. Proposed eval metrics: intent accuracy, slot F1, and human accept rate >= 85% on 100 QA pairs.
sam_eng: On infra: we'll provision a L4 dedicated pool (single node) with autoscale cushion. Need to confirm model variant (small vs. quantized large). Thomas, which model family should we test?
thomas_gridline: Start with base-7B quantized, happy to test a 13B if accuracy misses target.
irene_security: For questionnaire: we need to confirm data retention period, KMS provider, SOC2 status, and audit log access. Thomas, can your team sign a DPA and share necessary IP/breach contacts?
thomas_gridline: Yes, we can sign DPA. I'll send security contacts and DPA redline items today.
maya_ae: Action items summary: @chris_se — cost sensitivity + eval harness (due EOD tomorrow). @sam_eng — infra + model profile + runbook (due 48h). @irene_security — draft required security checklist and KMS/invoice items (due 48h). @alex_cs — pilot adoption plan + training doc. @thomas_gridline — 50 samples, security contact, confirm CIDR (due EOD). I'll send calendar invite for 30m in 30min.
deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: POC Kickoff — Gridline (30m) — 1768504500.ics
achris_se: small tweak — change latency target from 600ms p95 to 450ms if we go with the 13B? We should make it conditional in the runbook.
maya_ae: Noted. We'll include conditional targets. Any other blockers?
thomas_gridline: No blockers on our side. Looking forward.
alex_cs: I'll prepare a one-pager for executive overview + success metrics to share with Gridline leadership.
maya_ae: Great — thanks everyone. I'll send the invite and summary after this thread. :thumbsup:
